calculation.description: Ranks assets for reversal of the recent net move, with the reversal signal attenuated when the move followed a smooth directional path and emphasized when the path was choppy. Values are computed using only completed daily observations.

validation.regime_notes: Positive over 2027-2034 (10d IC 0.058607 and 0.046485); 2023-2026 was weak but positive. 2035 YTD is adverse (IC -0.069523 over 25 observations), so use conservative ensemble weight and monitor drift. Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
